---
title: How the platform works
subtitle: "One manuscript · every edition · verified"
---

```{=html}
<p class="guide-lead">You write chapters in Markdown in your own repository. One pinned toolkit checks them on every push, builds every edition from the same source and verifies each published file. You release your book; the hub owner approves every listing.</p>
<p class="actions"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="create.html">Create your handbook</a><a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="index.html#library">See a published handbook</a></p>

<p class="section-kicker">One manuscript, every edition</p>
<h2>Write once. Readers choose the format.</h2>
<ul class="edition-strip" aria-label="Editions built from one manuscript">
<li class="edition"><span class="edition-mark" aria-hidden="true">WEB</span><span class="edition-title">Reading site</span><span class="edition-text">Search, light and dark themes, linked cross-references, on any device.</span></li>
<li class="edition"><span class="edition-mark" aria-hidden="true">PDF</span><span class="edition-title">Print PDF</span><span class="edition-text">Numbered figures and tables, bookmarks, lists of figures and tables.</span></li>
<li class="edition"><span class="edition-mark" aria-hidden="true">DOC</span><span class="edition-title">Word</span><span class="edition-text">Contents and lists with page numbers, fonts embedded.</span></li>
<li class="edition"><span class="edition-mark" aria-hidden="true">MD</span><span class="edition-title">Markdown</span><span class="edition-text">The whole book in one file, ready for AI tools and <a href="llms.txt">llms.txt</a>.</span></li>
<li class="edition"><span class="edition-mark" aria-hidden="true">SRC</span><span class="edition-title">Sources</span><span class="edition-text">The exact manuscript of the release, with a manifest and checksums.</span></li>
</ul>

<p class="section-kicker">What the platform does for you</p>
<h2>The tedious parts are automatic.</h2>
<ul class="feature-grid">
<li class="feature"><span class="feature-mark" aria-hidden="true">{{icon:check}}</span><span class="feature-title">Checks on every push</span><span class="feature-text">Every push validates the structure, reading order, labels, cross-references and images; the release build adds the editorial profile.</span></li>
<li class="feature"><span class="feature-mark" aria-hidden="true">{{icon:hash}}</span><span class="feature-title">Numbering and references</span><span class="feature-text">Figures, tables and cross-references are numbered the same way in the web, PDF and Word editions, and links work in each.</span></li>
<li class="feature"><span class="feature-mark" aria-hidden="true">{{icon:layout}}</span><span class="feature-title">Print-ready layout</span><span class="feature-text">Headings stay with their text, figures stay near the paragraph that cites them, and tables stay with their caption.</span></li>
<li class="feature"><span class="feature-mark" aria-hidden="true">{{icon:shield}}</span><span class="feature-title">Verified releases</span><span class="feature-text">Each release carries a manifest and SHA-256 checksums. The deployed reading site is checked from the outside after every deployment.</span></li>
<li class="feature"><span class="feature-mark" aria-hidden="true">{{icon:pin}}</span><span class="feature-title">One pinned toolkit</span><span class="feature-text">Every book names an exact toolkit version, so the same commit is built the same way today and next year.</span></li>
<li class="feature"><span class="feature-mark" aria-hidden="true">{{icon:design}}</span><span class="feature-title">One design</span><span class="feature-text">Shared typography, colours and components across every book and this library, in light and dark.</span></li>
<li class="feature"><span class="feature-mark" aria-hidden="true">{{icon:people}}</span><span class="feature-title">People decide</span><span class="feature-text">A reviewer who did not write a change checks it. The author decides when to release; the hub owner approves every listing.</span></li>
<li class="feature"><span class="feature-mark" aria-hidden="true">{{icon:open}}</span><span class="feature-title">Free and open</span><span class="feature-text">Public repositories, release pages and static sites. Content under CC BY-SA 4.0, code under MIT.</span></li>
</ul>

<p class="section-kicker">Who owns what</p>
<h2>Independent books, shared standards.</h2>
<ul class="owner-grid">
<li class="owner"><span class="owner-title">Your book repository</span><span class="owner-text">Owns the manuscript, its reviews and its releases. Nothing is copied into the hub.</span></li>
<li class="owner"><span class="owner-title">The toolkit</span><span class="owner-text">One versioned tool that validates a manuscript and builds every edition the same way for every book.</span></li>
<li class="owner"><span class="owner-title">The release</span><span class="owner-text">Built once from an approved commit: reading site, PDF, Word, Markdown and sources, with a manifest and checksums.</span></li>
<li class="owner"><span class="owner-title">The catalog and this library</span><span class="owner-text">The catalog records approved releases only. This site is generated from it and links to the exact published files.</span></li>
</ul>

<p class="section-kicker">From manuscript to library</p>
<h2>Five steps, three of them by people.</h2>
<ol class="pipeline">
<li><span class="step-title">Write</span><span class="step-text">Chapters in Quarto Markdown in the book repository.</span><span class="step-meta">Author</span></li>
<li><span class="step-title">Check</span><span class="step-text">Automatic checks run on every push and pull request.</span><span class="step-meta">Automatic</span></li>
<li><span class="step-title">Release</span><span class="step-text">One workflow builds, verifies and publishes every edition and the reading site.</span><span class="step-meta">Author starts, then automatic</span></li>
<li><span class="step-title">Review</span><span class="step-text">Someone who did not write the change verifies the published files.</span><span class="step-meta">Reviewer</span></li>
<li><span class="step-title">List</span><span class="step-text">The owner approves the catalog change and this library rebuilds itself.</span><span class="step-meta">Owner</span></li>
</ol>
<p class="actions"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="create.html">Start your handbook</a><a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="publishing.html">How publishing works</a></p>
```
